title: System.Threading.Channels
description: Build producer-consumer pipelines with high-performance, thread-safe channels.

data.text: `System.Threading.Channels` provides a high-performance, thread-safe queue for passing data between producers and consumers asynchronously. It is ideal for pipelines, background processing, and throttling.
Create an unbounded channel and use `WriteAsync` and `ReadAsync` to pass messages between tasks.

data.title: Producer and Consumer

data.text: Use a bounded channel when you want backpressure to prevent the producer from overwhelming the consumer.

data.title: Bounded Channel with Backpressure

terms.definition: A thread-safe queue for async producer-consumer communication.
The side that writes items into the channel.
The side that reads items from the channel.
A mechanism that slows the producer when the consumer falls behind.

data.title: Important
data.text: Always call `Writer.Complete()` when the producer is done so consumers can exit gracefully.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: System.Threading.Channels is the modern way to build producer-consumer pipelines in .NET.

data.title: Exercise: Build a Producer-Consumer Pipeline
data.description: Create a bounded channel that processes numbers and writes results to the console.
steps: Start a producer that writes 10 numbers.
Start a consumer that reads and prints each number with a delay.
data.expectedOutcome: You understand how channels manage producer-consumer flow.
